Initial release: Analyze multi-angle pet videos to generate 3D body shape reconstruction and standardized Body Condition Score (BCS) (1–9) for cats, dogs, or other pets.

- Accepts local or network video uploads (multiple angles recommended: standing, side, top-down).
- Automatically evaluates pet BCS, classifies body type (underweight, ideal, overweight/obese), and outputs structured observation data.
- Strict open-id validation and cloud-based historical report lookup; no local memory usage permitted.
- Marked application scenarios: smart feeders, pet cameras, and pet health platforms.
- Analysis results are descriptive only—no diagnosis or treatment suggestions provided.
- Provides standardized Markdown tables with report links for historical data queries.
